question_text: The certificate of service of retiring officers on GL 07 and above requires the signature and counter-signature of………… and……….. while that of GL 06 and below requires the signature and counter-signature of………… and……………….
option_a: For GL 07 and above, it requires the signatures of the Permanent Secretary of FCSC, and the Permanent Secretary of the Officer’s MDA. On the other hand, For GL 06 and below, it requires the signatures of the Permanent Secretary of Career Management Office (CMO), and the Permanent Secretary of the Officer’s MDA.
option_b: For GL 07 and above, as well as GL 06 and below, the officers only need the endorsement of Deputy Director (Training and Staff Welfare) and the Director, Human Resources Management.
option_c: It requires the signature of the immediate supervisor of the retiring officer, in accordance with the extant public service rules (PSR).
